summary: Wrap Technologies filed an 8-K reporting Sept 2, 2026 Compensation Committee approval of amended and restated employment agreements with Executive Chairman/CEO Scot Cohen and a second executive, Jared Novick, plus performance restricted stock grants under Item 1.01. Cohen's package sets a $200,000 base salary, two-year initial term with automatic 12-month renewals requiring 90-day non-renewal notice, discretionary bonus eligibility, and severance of 12 months' base salary plus COBRA support on qualifying termination; 12-month non-compete applies. This is compensatory contracting rather than a forced departure; watch for equity grant dilution and any subsequent officer transition.
